note: Verbatim and correctly attributed to this shop. Two cautions. (1) 白双糖 is coarse Japanese crystal sugar (zarame), not 'white granulated sugar' — a small mistranslation worth fixing. (2) TRANSPLANT RISK: the only 「一切添加物を使用していない」 (no additives whatsoever) sentence in this article belongs to a DIFFERENT shop, だいこん屋, four paragraphs down — the Iwamura quote makes no additive claim, so 'no documented additives' must stay an absence statement and must never harden into an assurance. The article also calls the shell カステラ (castella — flour, egg, sugar), which is the citable basis for the record's not-vegan / not-GF verdicts.
